demo.name: brd2705a.demo.wisun_ncp
demo.label: Wi-SUN - NCP
demo.ns1:description: The Wi-SUN Network Co-Processor (NCP) application provides a complete Wi-SUN network interface implementation for embedded devices. This project implements a Network Co-Processor architecture where the Wi-SUN stack runs on a dedicated radio microcontroller, communicating with a host processor through UART or CPC (Co-Processor Communication) interfaces.
